metadata.description: 96 skills for Claude Code, grouped by task. 5 were run against a control and carry the numbers; the rest say plainly that they were not. Skills that failed the test are not here.

plugins.name: locul-build-mcp-servers
plugins.description: Six skills for the build side: the server itself, the transport and hosting, the authorisation flow, the tool schema, the test harness, and the submission package. 6 skills. None measured yet, and each skill says so.

plugins.name: locul-code-review
plugins.description: Review work where the knowledge is the hard part: which lock a migration takes, which shapes a race can have, what actually breaks a consumer of your API, and where the rest of the family of this bug lives. 6 skills. 1 of 6 measured against a control.

plugins.name: locul-copywriting
plugins.description: Six skills that produce copy rather than grading it. Each one carries a slot order, a device bank or a set of placement rules, because the model already writes a decent sentence and the ordering is where the work actually is. 7 skills. None measured yet, and each skill says so.

plugins.name: locul-frontend-design
plugins.description: The review side of front end work: the states nobody built, the attributes that decide whether a form autofills, the contrast maths, and where focus goes when the focused element is deleted. 9 skills. 2 of 9 measured against a control.

plugins.name: locul-humanize
plugins.description: Six separate passes, because the tells that give generated prose away live at six different levels and a single rewrite instruction reaches none of them reliably. 7 skills. None measured yet, and each skill says so.

plugins.name: locul-marketing
plugins.description: The parts of marketing that have a factual core a model gets wrong: authentication records, platform limits, named legal obligations, and the order operations have to happen in. 20 skills. 1 of 20 measured against a control.

plugins.name: locul-presentations
plugins.description: The deck already exists. These are for deciding whether it says one thing per slide, whether the chart is honest, and whether it survives being read rather than presented. 9 skills. None measured yet, and each skill says so.

plugins.name: locul-product-management
plugins.description: Six skills that produce the specification, the tickets, the blueprint and the decision. Each carries an ordering, a gate or a template where getting the sequence wrong is the expensive part. 6 skills. None measured yet, and each skill says so.

plugins.name: locul-research
plugins.description: Where a number came from, whether the source is what it appears to be, and the named biases that make a confident analysis wrong. 7 skills. None measured yet, and each skill says so.

plugins.name: locul-seo
plugins.description: Search work with a checkable core: what a results page is actually made of, which of your own pages are competing with each other, and why the traffic went away. 11 skills. 1 of 11 measured against a control.

plugins.name: locul-writing
plugins.description: Editing as an ordered set of passes, documentation as a typed artefact, and the two headline tests that replace taste with something falsifiable. 8 skills. None measured yet, and each skill says so.
